remarks: Welcome to 112 Hidden Ridge Common, a desirable 3 bedroom, 3 bath townhome offering approximately 2441 square feet of comfortable, maintenance-free living. This spacious 2 story home is the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and privacy. The first floor offers an open layout, with a kitchen leading to a dining room area, flowing into the spacious living room with large windows and skylights, which fill the space with natural light. The generously sized primary suite is a true retreat, with a cathedral ceiling, a ceiling fan, large walk-in closet, additional sink and makeup area, and a private bathroom with a shower and jacuzzi tub. The second bedroom includes built in cabinetry and offers excellent flexibility as a bedroom, home office, or den. A first floor laundry with included washer/dryer, and a full bath add to everyday convenience. A versatile loft overlooks the living room and provides additional living or office space. The loft includes a cedar closet and its own full bathroom. The house is located on a cul-de-sac, with the rear of the property backing the Buffalo Country Club, providing a greater sense of privacy and a peaceful backyard setting. Additional features include a newer driveway (2020), a newer front window (2022), an alarm system with cameras, central air, and a two car attached garage.
